full_prompt_en: A square noir-comic illustration puts a young adult woman's face extremely close in the left half. She looks back over her shoulder toward the viewer, dark eyes wide and brows arched. Her mouth is slightly open, suggesting sudden concern. Black hair curls around the cheeks and neck, merging with a dark coat collar at the lower left. Warm orange ink fills her face as a single dominant plane; black contour strokes and a few gray-olive shadow marks pick out nose, lips, eyelids, and cheek. At right, a narrow vertical wooden doorframe and adjacent panel create a hard divider. Beyond it is a hot orange exterior with bare black tree branches and a small cluster of black birds crossing the upper right. Scratched vertical lines and rough grain texture the wood and orange field. The image is cropped so tightly that only the head, neck, shoulder, and door edge remain; no complete body or room is shown. The face is largest and brightest, while the branches and birds read as ominous clues in a more distant space. Heavy black zones around the hair and coat make the orange skin glow, and the vertical door trim controls the division between human reaction and threatening outside. The rendering uses bold flat color blocks, rough brush contours, and selective fine hatch marks. It has almost no smooth shading or naturalistic depth. No readable text, speech balloon, or sign appears. The moment feels like a suspenseful turn within a larger story, relying on the startled glance, narrow doorway, and stark black-orange palette rather than visible violence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑色电影式漫画把一位年轻成年女子的脸极近地放在左半。她越肩向观者回头，深眼睁大，眉拱起，嘴稍开，显出突然担忧。黑发在脸颊与颈旁卷曲，并与左下深衣领相融。暖橙墨色把脸填成一处主平面；黑轮廓和少量灰橄榄阴影挑出鼻、唇、眼睑与脸颊。右边窄竖木门框与相邻门板形成硬分界。其外是热橙色空间，裸黑树枝横过，几只小黑鸟从右上飞过。刮痕般竖线和粗颗粒给木头、橙色域添纹。图像裁切极紧，只留头、颈、肩与门边，看不到完整身体或房间。脸最大最亮，枝与鸟在更远空间中像不祥线索。发和衣周围重黑区使橙脸发亮，竖门框控制人物反应与外部威胁的分界。绘制使用大胆平面色块、粗笔轮廓和选择性细排线，几乎没有平滑明暗或自然纵深。没有可读文字、对话气泡或标牌。瞬间像更大故事中的悬疑转身，依赖惊讶一瞥、窄门洞与锋利黑橙色盘，而非可见暴力。
style_prompt_en: The noir-comic finish reduces color to hot orange, dense black, and a few muted gray-olive strokes. Broad flat light areas are sliced by assertive inky contours, a rigid vertical divider, and thin branching silhouettes. Close cropping amplifies one expressive focal shape while distant small birdlike marks add unease. Rough dry-brush edges, scratches, and hatching provide tactile print texture without soft photographic shading. Large black hairlike and clothlike masses make the warm center glow. The spatial design is simple but tense: near form on one side, narrow threshold in the middle, ominous graphic distance beyond. The result feels like a pulp mystery panel—dramatic, restrained, and instantly legible through high contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 黑色电影漫画完成度把颜色缩为热橙、浓黑和少数低饱和灰橄榄笔迹。宽阔平面光区被果断墨轮廓、坚硬竖向分界和细枝状剪影切开。近裁切放大一处有表情的焦点形，远方少数鸟状小记号添不安。粗干笔边、刮痕与排线提供可触印刷纹理，却不用柔软摄影明暗。大块黑发般和布般团块使暖色中央发亮。空间设计简单但紧张：近形在一侧，中间窄门槛，另一侧是不祥图形化远方。结果像通俗悬疑漫画格——戏剧性、克制，并由高对比立即可读。
theme_en: A startled dark-haired woman looks back through a doorway in a black-and-orange noir comic
theme_zh: 黑橙双色黑色电影漫画中，深发女子在门边惊讶地回头
name: Francesco Francavilla
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
